preparation.preparation: Original raw split boundaries and test sampling seeds preserved except BAF calibration/train change; no test oversampling.

selection_rule: v2 weakest temporal-block utility minus 0.25 positive train/selection AP-above-random gap, 0.15 positive ROC-AUC gap and 0.10 validation block AP drop. Per-family and champion floors: at least 95% incumbent validation AP, 85% incumbent recall at 1% calibration budget, and utility no more than 0.03 below incumbent. Incumbents remain eligible. No test-based selection.
limitations: Previously inspected test periods are exploratory, not a fresh final holdout. Validation FPR budgets are not guarantees on test or deployment. AP is average_precision_score, not trapezoidal integration. Historical label features, where used, require operational availability assumptions. Fit-gap diagnostics are warnings, not guarantees of no over/underfitting. AP-above-random rescales the random baseline but does not fully correct prevalence shift. Reused validation can itself be overfit; use a new future holdout for confirmation. Learning capacity is screened, not mathematically proven optimal.
